- **Deal:** Each player gets two cards down and one up. Three more up cards and a last down card follow, with betting after every street.
- **Win:** The best five of your seven cards wins, using standard rankings.
- **Round one:** Your 9♥ is the lowest up card, so you act first. You can check, bet 20 or fold.
